key_findings: Spinal P-Rex2 is upregulated in bone cancer pain and its knockdown relieves hyperalgesia, spine formation, p-Rac1, p-GluR1 and enhanced AMPAR currents
P-Rex2 acts via Rac1/pGluR1 to regulate AMPAR trafficking and spine morphology
